values.note: Booked online through the operator's Keepr page; paid in full at booking. Cancellations within 24 hours of booking are free, then a $15 fee up to 10 days out; inside 10 days the first night is forfeited. Rustic sites take 1-14 night stays. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

note: Family campground on the west shore of private Sunrise Lake at 15230 S Spencer Rd near LeRoy, beside the DNR ATV trails and near the Evart Motorcycle Loop; premium sites have lake views, standard sites are a short walk from the beach. Swimming beach, splash pad, boat launch access, pavilion; cabins and rental campers booked through Airbnb. Distinct from Sunrise Lake State Forest Campground (id 14036) 650 m south. Google 4.9 over 77 reviews. --Claude
